blocks.text: MANDAUE CITY, Cebu — With dengue cases surging in parts of Cebu and other areas of the country, the Philippine Red Cross (PRC) assured the public that it has sufficient blood supply to meet current demand. PRC Secretary General Dr. Gwen Pang urged the public not to spread misinformation about an alleged blood supply shortage […]...
